what_this_is: the interval D002 did not report on the margin that selected the negative set. The choice is preregistered and is not revised.
protocol: negative_diagnostic.py's: uniform 60,000-peptide sample of the union as positives, length-matched unobserved decoys, closed-form LDA on 20-dim composition, first half fits and second half scores, midrank AUROC
bootstrap: paired on positives, which are the same peptides in both arms; each arm resamples its own negatives independently
reading: A margin whose interval crosses zero does not establish that set C is the harder set. D002 is sound on its stated rationale -- same expression context -- and that rationale, not this margin, is what the choice rests on.
